illustrations.title: Turn “safe” into a checkable requirement
illustrations.caption: Create a task successfully, restart the process, and check that the task remains. This requirement concerns a process restart with committed storage intact.

illustrations.title: Choose, record, and review a design
illustrations.caption: Write down the requirements, compare choices, and record the decision. Later, use measurements and changed requirements to decide whether the design still fits.

illustrations.title: Check requirements before scoring preferences
illustrations.caption: Memory-only storage loses tasks after restart, so we reject it for this application. We compare preference scores only for choices that meet the required behaviour.

illustrations.title: Availability and durability answer different questions
